title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: EDL Group Directors, EDL Group employees and regular EDL Group contractors
tiers.description: All directors, employees and regular contractors of the EDL Group. Subject to the insider trading ban, the no-short-term-trading rule (six-month buy/sell) and the blackout periods.

tiers.name: EDL Group Directors
tiers.description: Directors; notify the Chairman before trading (Chairman notifies the Chairman of the Audit and Risk Committee before his own trades), and must ensure the Company Secretary has enough notice to lodge the ASX notification within 5 business days of a trade.

tiers.name: EDL Group employees and regular EDL Group contractors
tiers.description: Employees and regular contractors who are not directors; notify the Managing Director before trading.

tiers.name: EDL Group Directors and EDL Group employees
tiers.description: Directors and employees (contractors excluded); the group subject to the hedging provisions covering unvested and vested plan securities.

tiers.name: Employees with options, rights or similar instruments
tiers.description: Employees who have or may receive options, rights or similar instruments over the Company's securities under a Company plan; barred from transacting in associated products (such as warrants) without prior Board approval.

tiers.name: Key Management Personnel
tiers.description: Directors and employees who are key management personnel for the Company's financial statements; must advise the Company Secretary as soon as possible after a trade.

definitions.hedging_definition: where a person enters into transactions in products associated with the Company's securities which operate to limit the economic risk of their security holding in the Company

windows.start_anchor: 31 days immediately before the release of the Company's half yearly results
windows.end_anchor: 2 days immediately following release of the half yearly results

windows.start_anchor: 31 days immediately before the release of the Company's full year results
windows.end_anchor: 2 days immediately following release of the full year results

windows.start_anchor: 14 days immediately before the Annual General Meeting
windows.end_anchor: 2 days immediately following the Annual General Meeting

rules.tier: Employees with options, rights or similar instruments
rules.detail: Employees who hold or may receive options, rights or similar instruments under a Company plan cannot deal in third-party products associated with the Company's securities (e.g. warrants) without prior Board approval; no distinction is drawn between exchange-traded and OTC products.
rules.evidence: Employees who have or may receive options, rights or similar instruments over the Company's securities may not enter into transactions in associated products (such as warrants) without the prior approval of the Board.

rules.tier: EDL Group Directors and EDL Group employees
rules.detail: Absolute ban on hedging unvested securities issued under any Company share scheme, Performance Rights Plan or Option Plan.
rules.evidence: EDL Group Directors and EDL Group employees must not engage in hedging arrangements over unvested securities issued pursuant to any Company share scheme, Performance Rights Plan or Option Plan.

rules.tier: EDL Group Directors and EDL Group employees
rules.detail: Vested plan securities may be hedged only once exercised into an actual shareholding, and only if the hedge details are fully disclosed (e.g. to the ASX and in the Annual Report) and the hedge is itself treated and notified as a sale or purchase of securities under the policy.
rules.evidence: In relation to vested securities, these may only be hedged once they are exercised into shareholdings and only on the condition that the details of the hedge are fully disclosed (eg: to the ASX and in the Annual Report, as appropriate), and that the hedge transaction is treated as a sale or purchase of securities and the relevant notifications must be made in accordance with this policy.

rules.tier: EDL Group Directors and EDL Group employees
rules.detail: Monetisation is not named, but a prepaid forward or similar arrangement is a 'transaction in a product associated with the Company's securities which operates to limit the economic risk' of the holding, so it is caught by the hedging provision (unvested: banned; vested: disclosed and notified as a sale/purchase).
rules.evidence: Hedging arrangements include where a person enters into transactions in products associated with the Company's securities which operate to limit the economic risk of their security holding in the Company.

rules.detail: Short selling is not named; only the distinct 'short term trading' concept (buy and sell within six months) is addressed.
Securities lending is not mentioned anywhere in the policy.

rules.tier: Employees with options, rights or similar instruments
rules.detail: CFDs are not named but would be a 'product associated with the Company's securities' like the named example (warrants), so a plan-holding employee would need prior Board approval; if the CFD also limits economic risk it is separately caught by the hedging provision.
rules.evidence: Employees who have or may receive options, rights or similar instruments over the Company's securities may not enter into transactions in associated products (such as warrants) without the prior approval of the Board.

rules.detail: Margin loans are not mentioned anywhere in the policy.
Granting security, a charge, lien or pledge over the Company's securities is not mentioned anywhere.
No secured financing provision exists in the policy.
Purchase and sale of the same securities within six months is prohibited, relaxable at the Board's discretion in very limited circumstances (e.g. exercising employee share plan options).
rules.evidence: EDL Group Directors, EDL Group employees and regular EDL Group contractors may not engage in the short term trading of the securities of the Company, eg. a purchase and sale of the same securities within a six month period.

clearance.approver: Chairman (Chairman of the Audit and Risk Committee if the Director is the Chairman)
clearance.evidence: If intending to trade in the Company's securities, the following notifications of intended trading must be made ... in the case of EDL Group Directors, notification to the Chairman; in the case of the Chairman, notification to the Chairman of the Audit and Risk Committee

clearance.tier: EDL Group employees and regular EDL Group contractors
clearance.evidence: in the case of EDL Group employees and regular EDL Group contractors, notification to the Managing Director.

clearance.approver: Chairman (Chairman of the Audit and Risk Committee if the Director is the Chairman)
clearance.evidence: Approval to trade during a blackout period will only be granted in exceptional personal circumstances, upon prior notice to and approval from: in the case of EDL Group Directors, the Chairman

clearance.tier: EDL Group employees and regular EDL Group contractors
clearance.evidence: Approval to trade during a blackout period will only be granted in exceptional personal circumstances, upon prior notice to and approval from ... in the case of EDL Group employees and regular EDL Group contractors, the Managing Director

clearance.tier: Employees with options, rights or similar instruments
clearance.evidence: Employees who have or may receive options, rights or similar instruments over the Company's securities may not enter into transactions in associated products (such as warrants) without the prior approval of the Board.

clearance.post_trade_deadline: as soon as possible after the trade; for Directors, in sufficient time for the Company Secretary to notify ASX within 5 business days of the trade
clearance.evidence: EDL Group Directors and EDL Group employees who are “key management personnel” for the purposes of the Company's financial statements are to advise the Company Secretary as soon as possible after a trade involving Company securities has occurred.

short_term.basis: purchase and sale of the same securities within the period
carve_outs: Board discretion to relax the requirement in very limited circumstances, such as the exercising of options in employee share ownership plans
short_term.evidence: EDL Group Directors, EDL Group employees and regular EDL Group contractors may not engage in the short term trading of the securities of the Company, eg. a purchase and sale of the same securities within a six month period.

exceptions.evidence: EDL Group Directors, EDL Group employees and regular EDL Group contractors may acquire or sell shares during a blackout period through a general offer to all shareholders, such as a Dividend Reinvestment Plan, a Share Purchase Plan, or a general buy-back offer.
In very limited circumstances, such as the exercising of options in employee share ownership plans, this requirement may be relaxed at the discretion of the Board.

external_documents: Company share scheme / Performance Rights Plan / Option Plan rules
exemption_authority: The Board may approve a trade during a blackout period in exceptional personal circumstances (undefined) via the Chairman (Chairman of the Audit and Risk Committee if the Chairman is trading) or the Managing Director for employees/contractors; the Board may also relax the six-month short-term trading rule in very limited circumstances such as employee share plan option exercises, and must pre-approve any dealing by plan-holding employees in associated products such as warrants.

bespoke_clauses.topic: no margin lending or secured financing provision
bespoke_clauses.clause: (no reference to margin loans, encumbrances or secured financing anywhere in the policy)
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A loan secured on the collared shares is not itself regulated by this policy, so the bank's financing leg faces no express prohibition, consent or disclosure gate, only the general insider-trading and blackout rules applicable to any resulting dealing.

bespoke_clauses.clause: these may only be hedged once they are exercised into shareholdings and only on the condition that the details of the hedge are fully disclosed (eg: to the ASX and in the Annual Report, as appropriate), and that the hedge transaction is treated as a sale or purchase of securities
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The collar's put/call legs on exercised (vested) shares must be publicly disclosed to the ASX and in the Annual Report and treated as a notifiable sale/purchase, so the structure cannot be kept confidential and triggers the Director's 5-business-day ASX notice.

bespoke_clauses.clause: EDL Group Directors and EDL Group employees must not engage in hedging arrangements over unvested securities issued pursuant to any Company share scheme, Performance Rights Plan or Option Plan.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A collar cannot be written over unvested plan entitlements at all; the underlying equity must first vest and be exercised into an actual shareholding before a collar can be considered.

bespoke_clauses.clause: (the policy nowhere mentions spouses, dependants, family trusts or controlled entities)
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unlike most comparable ASX policies, this one does not expressly extend any restriction to associates, so structuring the collar or loan through a spouse or family entity may fall outside its stated scope, though this creates interpretive risk given the policy's stated fairness purpose.

summary: A funded collar looks achievable in principle, but only once the underlying equity has vested and been exercised into an actual shareholding: unvested securities under any Company share scheme, Performance Rights Plan or Option Plan cannot be hedged at all, whereas vested, exercised shares may be hedged if the hedge details are fully disclosed (including to the ASX and in the Annual Report) and the hedge is treated and notified as a sale or purchase under the policy. An employee who holds or may receive plan options must separately obtain prior Board approval before transacting in any product associated with the Company's securities, such as a warrant, which would extend to the put/call legs of a collar. The policy is entirely silent on margin lending, encumbrance and secured financing, so the bank's loan secured on the collared shares is not itself regulated, though entry, unwind or settlement must still avoid the half-year, full-year and AGM blackout periods (absent Board-approved exceptional-circumstances clearance) and requires advance notification to the Chairman (Directors) or Managing Director (employees/contractors), plus post-trade reporting to the Company Secretary and, for Directors, an ASX notice within five business days. The policy does not address associates (spouses, trusts, controlled entities) at all, which should be clarified before routing any part of the structure through a related party.
